data.name: Bhabesh
data.gender_notes: Bhabesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhava’ meaning happiness and ‘ish’ meaning lord. Bhabesh is the name of a deity who is believed to bring happiness and joy to one's life. The name Bhabesh carries the meaning “Lord of happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhabesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhabesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhabesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Bhabesh Chakrabarti (b. 1954) is a renowned Indian-American mathematician and statistician who has made significant contributions to the fields of combinatorics, algebraic graph theory, and statistical learning theory.

Bhabesh Chandra Sen (1853–1931) was an Indian philosopher and scholar who was a prominent figure in the Bengali Renaissance movement and is known for his contributions to the fields of Indian philosophy, literature and education. He was a key figure in the development of the Brahmo Samaj, a progressive Hindu reform movement in late 19th century.
